blocks.text:
To: James Garcia
Cc: Michelle Banks

Thank you for the quick turnaround on the second extract. It reconciles cleanly. The cession schedule now ties to the premium records, and with the two treaty inception dates you confirmed last week, the schedule of treaties is settled on our side.

One item is still open on the loss data. That file carries paid amounts but not case reserves, and we need both to set the experience against the pricing in the {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} review. If your reinsurance accounting group can add the case reserves to the next extract, and confirm that the treaty codes there match the ones on the premium side, the intake is closed. Neither is pressing before next week; a first read on what is readily available is enough to keep us moving.

Michelle Banks is running the reconciliation and will keep her questions on this thread, a few at a time, so the whole record sits in one place. Everything your team at Gonzalez, Campbell and Kelly has sent so far has come through clean, and for this early stretch we are in good shape. I will confirm once the reserves are in and tell you what, if anything, still needs a follow-up.
